description: Build and validate Terraform modules for individual services

questions.question: Does the service module follow terraform-standards (pinned providers, no hardcoded secrets)?
Are all provider versions pinned with ~> constraints?
questions.notes: Prevents breaking changes from minor/patch updates

questions.question: Are all variables externalized (no hardcoded values in main.tf)?
questions.notes: Region, instance types, counts, subnets — all in variables.tf

questions.question: Are outputs correctly exported for other modules?
questions.notes: Downstream services need IDs, ARNs, endpoints from this module

questions.question: Are all resources tagged with Name and Environment tags?
questions.notes: Consistent tagging for billing and resource tracking

questions.question: Did terraform validate and fmt succeed without errors?
Does terraform plan show expected resource count?
questions.notes: Plan output should match architecture intent
